You can cancel your order at any time before it has been processed and shipped. Once an order has been processed, we are unfortunately unable to cancel it.

You can cancel your order at any time before it has been processed and shipped. Once an order has been processed, we are unfortunately unable to cancel it.

If you would like to cancel an order you just placed, please share your order number and email address so I can assist you!
